caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded body, a slightly narrower neck, a wide circular mouth, and a handle attached to the upper part of the vessel. The jug is rendered in shades of brown, olive green, and muted yellow, with a mottled and marbled texture that features irregular yellow and dark greenish lines running vertically and horizontally across the surface, creating a crackle pattern. The shading on the jug suggests a three-dimensional form with subtle highlights and shadows. The handle is positioned on the right side of the jug and curves outward, connecting the mouth and the upper body. The background is plain, light beige, and unadorned, drawing focus to the jug itself. The artist's signature, "JESSICA PRICE," is visible in small, light letters near the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Jar with Cover
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
